name: Flexible Childcare Assistance
description: Flexible Childcare Assistance is an extra help product providing childcare assistance to eligible clients based on residence, age, shared care arrangements, risk of long-term benefit receipt, childcare arrangements, and specified employment activity.

attributes.summary: A childcare assistance payment for clients at risk of long-term benefit receipt who are undertaking specified employment activity, covering qualifications, payment, changes, and ending conditions.
